cb61e3b29f0738c7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ماز الحديثة للشحن عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مراجعة البيانات وتدقيقها، بالإضافة إلى إدخالها وتخزينها باستخدام أنظمة الحاسب الآلي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة استمارات البيانات وترميزها والتأكد من اكتمال جميع المعلومات المطلوبة. إدخال البيانات والمعلومات بدقة في أنظمة الحاسب الآلي، مع الالتزام بالبرامج والنظم الإحصائية المعتمدة. مراجعة رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة وتصحيح أي أخطاء يتم اكتشافها لضمان دقة البيانات. تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بطريقة منظمة وآمنة. تنفيذ النسخ الاحتياطية الدورية واللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة. الالتزام الصارم بالتعليمات والسياسات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات وحمايتها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال إدخال البيانات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على مراجعة وتدقيق البيانات بدقة عالية. إتقان استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج إدخال البيانات. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالسرية المهنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل مدخل البيانات ضمن بيئة منظمة تلتزم بمعايير الدقة والسرية في التعامل مع المعلومات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

cb91f000c2e88307.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Specialist - Cloud Operation to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This is a full-time position focused on managing and optimizing cloud environments to ensure reliable and efficient operations. Role Purpose The Senior Specialist – Cloud Operations is responsible for the daily operation, administration, monitoring, and optimization of the organization’s cloud environments. This role ensures cloud services remain available, secure, reliable, and cost-efficient, while providing advanced technical support and driving automation and continuous operational improvement. Key Responsibilities Operate, administer, monitor, and support enterprise cloud platforms and services. Ensure the availability, stability, performance, and operational readiness of cloud environments. Monitor cloud infrastructure and proactively identify and resolve performance, capacity, availability, and configuration issues. Provide L3 technical support for complex cloud incidents, service requests, and change requests. Perform cloud platform patching, upgrades, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle activities. Implement automation to improve operational efficiency and reduce repetitive manual activities. Support cloud security controls, identity and access management, configuration standards, backup, and disaster recovery. Support incident, problem, and change management activities, including root-cause analysis for recurring or critical issues. Monitor cloud utilization and support FinOps/cost optimization activities to improve resource efficiency. Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, runbooks, and SOPs. Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Network, Application, Architecture, and DevOps teams to resolve operational issues and support new solutions. Support cloud migrations, deployments, configuration changes, and integration with on-premises infrastructure. Maintain monitoring, alerting, backup, recovery, and high-availability capabilities. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in cloud reliability, scalability, security, and operational processes. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Typically 5–8 years of relevant IT/infrastructure experience, including strong hands-on exposure to cloud operations. Hands-on experience with one or more major platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, offering an opportunity to contribute to the operational excellence of cloud environments.

cbaf9980f9b0262a.job_title: Technical Manager Project Management & Strategic Planning
cbaf9980f9b0262a.description: About SJ Group Surbana Jurong Group (SJ Group) is a global consulting firm specializing in urban, infrastructure, and managed services. The company provides integrated solutions across the entire project lifecycle, from planning and design to delivery and asset management, with a strong presence in Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and other regions. About the Role SJ Group is seeking an experienced Technical Manager – Project Management & Strategic Planning to support the management of major infrastructure programs and capital portfolios. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah, and combines project management operations, PMO governance, strategic planning, performance monitoring, and portfolio reporting. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate project management operations within a PMO environment. Develop, review, and improve project management policies, procedures, and governance frameworks. Support strategic planning and the management of capital project portfolios. Monitor project and portfolio performance against strategic objectives, schedules, and delivery targets. Prepare and analyze project performance reports, KPIs, and management dashboards. Oversee the implementation of project management systems and Enterprise Project Management (EPM) tools. Coordinate project data, reporting processes, and performance monitoring across infrastructure programs. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Proven experience in project management operations and PMO governance. Demonstrated ability in strategic planning and capital project portfolio management. Working with SJ Group Joining SJ Group means becoming part of a global, multidisciplinary consultancy that operates in over 40 countries. The company focuses on shaping sustainable, people-centric environments and offers the opportunity to work alongside world-class teams on major infrastructure programs and strategic development initiatives.

cbb6f25e855b420f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الغراء للتعليم عن معلم للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تدريس الطلاب في مجال التخصص، وتقديم الدعم لتنميتهم الأكاديمية والشخصية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تدريس الطلاب في مجال التخصص المحدد، مع التركيز على تقديم تعليم فعال. وضع خطط الدروس التي تتوافق مع موضوع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة. تقديم التعليمات للطلاب بشكل فردي وجماعي، مع مراعاة الاحتياجات التعليمية المتنوعة. دعم التنمية الشاملة للطلاب، بما في ذلك الجوانب الأكاديمية والاجتماعية. اختيار المصادر التعليمية المناسبة لدعم عملية التعلم. تصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس وغيرها من طرق التدريس والمحتوى. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التعليم أو التدريس. القدرة على تدريس الطلاب في مجال تخصص محدد. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل المعلم ضمن بيئة تعليمية تهدف إلى دعم التنمية الأكاديمية للطلاب. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

cbbde354d05fe824.description: About the Role Radian Engineering Consulting Company is seeking a Mechanical Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing the design and supervising the execution of mechanical works within projects, ensuring adherence to approved plans and specifications, and maintaining quality and operational safety. The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of experience in mechanical engineering. Key Responsibilities Prepare and review plans, technical specifications, and bills of quantities for mechanical works before execution. Supervise the implementation of HVAC, plumbing, sanitary drainage, and fire fighting network systems. Review shop drawings and approve materials, equipment, and samples in accordance with specifications. Coordinate with other disciplines (electrical, civil, architectural) to avoid on-site conflicts. Inspect and receive works, and monitor pressure tests, commissioning, trial operations, and handover. Ensure works comply with the Saudi Building Code, technical requirements, and Civil Defense regulations. Review executed quantities and contractor statements, verifying their accuracy. Monitor work progress against the timeline and prepare periodic reports for the Project Manager. Track Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and follow up on their resolution until closure. Monitor the application of occupational health and safety requirements on site. Perform any other tasks assigned by the Project Manager within the scope of the specialization. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from an accredited university. Valid membership in the Saudi Council of Engineers. Knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, and fire fighting systems, and relevant standards (SBC, NFPA, ASHRAE). Proficiency in AutoCAD and Microsoft Office; knowledge of Revit MEP is a plus. Ability to read mechanical plans, bills of quantities, and specifications. Proficiency in Arabic, with good knowledge of technical English. Coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work in the field and under tight deadlines. Minimum of 5 years of experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring on-site presence and coordination with various project stakeholders.

cb36e3d634bf9425.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking a Planner (Saudi National) to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves developing, maintaining, and analyzing integrated project schedules across various phases of major infrastructure or mega projects, including design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover activities. Key Responsibilities Develop, update, and maintain detailed project schedules for all project phases. Support the development and maintenance of the Integrated Master Schedule. Perform critical path, near-critical path, float, logic, and schedule trend analysis. Identify schedule risks, delays, constraints, and potential impacts to key project milestones. Coordinate with various project teams (engineering, procurement, construction, etc.) to ensure realistic schedules. Review contractor and subcontractor baseline schedules, updates, and recovery plans. Support the development and application of progress measurement methods and verify reported progress. Monitor schedule risks, constraints, and opportunities, and assist with risk analysis and forecasting. Analyze the impact of changes, delays, and disruptions, and support time impact analyses. Integrate contractor and supplier schedules into the project and Integrated Master Schedule. Utilize Primavera P6 and other relevant project controls tools for schedule management and reporting. Prepare weekly, monthly, and ad hoc schedule reports, including dashboards and visual reports. Promote and comply with all health, safety, security, environmental, and wellbeing requirements. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, or a related field. A Higher National Diploma in a relevant field may also be acceptable. Minimum of 6 years of experience in project planning and scheduling, with a total experience range of 5-10 years. Experience supporting major infrastructure, rail, transportation, industrial, or large-scale construction projects. Demonstrable experience developing and managing schedules for multidisciplinary projects. Proficiency in Primavera P6, including schedule development, baseline management, updates, coding, critical path analysis, and reporting. Strong knowledge of planning methodologies, critical path analysis, resource allocation, progress measurement, and schedule forecasting. Experience supporting the integration of scope, cost, risk, resources, and schedule within project control structures. Knowledge of earned value management and project performance reporting. Experience supporting schedule risk analysis, recovery planning, mitigation planning, and delay assessment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Desired Skills and Certifications Experience working on a mega project, major infrastructure program, or complex multidisciplinary project. Experience with cost-loaded, resource-loaded, and risk-adjusted schedules. Knowledge of schedule risk analysis, Monte Carlo simulation, and confidence-level forecasting. Proficiency with Power BI, advanced Microsoft Excel, and automated project controls reporting. Familiarity with FIDIC, NEC, or other international forms of contract. PMP, PMI-SP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, AACE, or equivalent certification is desirable. Primavera P6 certification is highly desirable. Experience working in Saudi Arabia and/or the Gulf region is highly preferred. Work Environment The Planner will work in a dynamic project environment, coordinating with various internal and external stakeholders including clients, contractors, consultants, and suppliers. The role requires the ability to manage competing priorities and meet demanding deadlines. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

cb4362a97c2863f5.description: About Jumeirah and Jumeirah Jabal Omar Jumeirah, a member of DUBAI HOLDING, is a global luxury hospitality company operating 29 properties across 11 countries. The brand is recognized for its distinguished resorts, city hotels, and residences. Jumeirah Jabal Omar Makkah is located minutes from Masjid Al Haram, offering comfort and Arabian hospitality. The hotel features dining venues, retail outlets, a gym, executive lounge, and meeting spaces, with views of the Grand Mosque and a diverse culinary offering. About the Role: Commis 1 – Staff Canteen An opportunity has arisen for a Commis 1 to join the Staff Canteen team at Jumeirah Jabal Omar in Makkah. This full-time role involves supporting kitchen operations and food preparation for the staff canteen, ensuring adherence to established recipes and standards. Key Responsibilities Execute orders from the Chef de Partie accurately, following instructions and recommendations to complete daily tasks. Gather, measure, mix, and prepare meal ingredients, sauces, and seasonings according to established recipes and specifications. Wash, peel, and chop vegetables, fruits, and meats with precision, demonstrating proficiency in cutting, seasoning, and marinating as required. Perform cooking techniques and plating to exact specifications provided by the Demi Chef or Chef de Partie, ensuring high standards. Document inventory of kitchen supplies, monitor stock levels, and notify supervisors of low stock situations to maintain sufficient supplies. Operate kitchen equipment such as braising pans, ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers effectively, ensuring correct settings for cooking and baking temperatures. Qualifications and Experience 1-2 years of experience in various kitchen areas, preferably within the luxury hospitality industry. College Degree in Culinary Arts or a similar field from an accredited Culinary School. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Work Environment This role is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within the Jumeirah Jabal Omar Hotel. The position is full-time and involves working in a dynamic kitchen environment focused on serving the staff canteen.

cb7934f09069f6fa.job_title: Executive Pastry Chef – Upscale Hospitality Group
cb7934f09069f6fa.description: We are currently seeking an experienced and visionary Head Pastry Chef to lead the pastry and bakery operations for a highly anticipated premium café concept in Al Khobar. This role is fundamental in shaping the identity of the venue through exceptional craftsmanship, precision, and innovation. We are looking for a leader who combines technical mastery with operational discipline and a refined creative vision. The Role As our Head Pastry Chef, you will oversee all pastry and bakery production, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with international luxury standards. You will lead the pastry team, manage daily operations, and contribute strategically to menu development, product innovation, and cost control. Your leadership will directly influence guest satisfaction and commercial performance. Your Profile Professional Experience Minimum 5–8 years of professional pastry experience, including at least 2–3 years in a leadership role within a premium patisserie, fine dining restaurant, or upscale café concept. Proven expertise in high-end pastry, viennoiserie, and baked goods, with strong attention to flavor balance, texture, and presentation. Experience managing production planning in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Leadership & Team Development You lead and mentor your team with clarity, structure, and high-performance standards. You are confident in training, scheduling, and developing junior chefs while fostering a collaborative and disciplined kitchen culture. You maintain composure and authority during peak production periods. Menu Development & Brand Alignment You contribute to the creation and evolution of refined pastry and bakery menus aligned with the brand identity. You collaborate closely with senior culinary leadership on tastings, seasonal launches, and product innovation. You stay informed of international pastry trends and apply them thoughtfully to enhance the concept. Operational & Financial Acumen You actively manage food cost, portion control, and waste reduction to optimize profitability. You oversee inventory, supplier coordination, and purchasing to maintain ingredient quality and operational efficiency. You ensure production schedules are organized, structured, and aligned with daily business needs. Quality & Compliance You maintain meticulous attention to detail across flavor, texture, and visual presentation. You enforce strict adherence to food safety, hygiene, and local regulatory standards at all times. You ensure the pastry section consistently meets brand and operational expectations. What We Offer Staff discounts across the wider international hospitality group and sister companies. A very attractive reward scheme program. 2 days off per week + 30 days annual leave. Comprehensive medical insurance. A leadership role within an expanding international concept, with opportunities for future mobility and growth.

cbbe876f8fcee4c8.description: عرض وظيفي – محاسب عام السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته، يسر شركة نغم الجزيرة لتأجير السيارات تقديم عرض وظيفي لكم لشغل منصب محاسب عام، ونتطلع إلى استقطاب كفاءة مهنية تمتلك الخبرة العملية في المحاسبة والإدارة المالية والأنظمة الضريبية المعمول بها في المملكة العربية السعودية، بما يسهم في رفع كفاءة الأداء المالي وتطوير أعمال الشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات: * تسجيل وترحيل القيود المحاسبية اليومية، وإعداد قيود التسويات والإقفالات الشهرية والسنوية. * مراجعة الإيرادات والمصروفات والفواتير والمستندات المالية والتأكد من صحتها. * متابعة إيرادات تأجير السيارات والعقود والتحصيلات والمبالغ المستحقة. * إجراء التسويات البنكية ومطابقة حسابات العملاء والموردين والصندوق. * الإلمام بضريبة القيمة المضافة وإعداد ومراجعة الإقرارات الضريبية وفق الأنظمة المعمول بها. * متابعة متطلبات الفوترة الإلكترونية وهيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك. * إعداد ميزان المراجعة والتقارير المالية الدورية ومتابعة الذمم المدينة والدائنة. * تنظيم الملفات والمستندات المحاسبية، ومراجعة الأرصدة ومعالجة الفروقات والأخطاء. * إجادة استخدام البرامج المحاسبية، والالتزام بالدقة والسرية والمواعيد النظامية. الاختبار المهني وشروط المباشرة: يشترط استكمال إجراءات التوظيف خضوع المرشح لاختبار مهني لدى مكتب محاسبة معتمد، للتحقق من خبرته في القيود المحاسبية والضرائب وإعداد الإقرارات الضريبية. وفي حال اجتياز الاختبار بنجاح، تُستكمل إجراءات المباشرة ونقل الخدمات وفق الأنظمة المعمول بها في المملكة العربية السعودية. أما في حال عدم الاجتياز، فتُحدد مسؤولية رسوم الاختبار وفق اتفاق مكتوب مسبقًا وبما يتوافق مع الأنظمة ذات العلاقة. تؤمن الشركة ببناء علاقة عمل طويلة الأمد مع الكفاءات المتميزة، وتقديم عرض مالي يتناسب مع الخبرة والكفاءة وحجم المسؤوليات، وفق ما يتم الاتفاق عليه بين الطرفين. نتطلع إلى مناقشة تفاصيل العرض الوظيفي معكم، وبناء علاقة مهنية قائمة على الثقة والأمانة والالتزام والإنجاز. وتفضلوا بقبول خالص التقدير والاحترام. إدارة شركة نغم الجزيرة لتأجير السيارات

cbf1c395e42c3fa2.description: General Accountant — 1 to 2 years of experience. A company specializing in corporate services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia announces its need for a General Accountant to contribute to organizing daily financial operations, ensuring the accuracy of records, and preparing reports that support performance monitoring and decision-making. Tasks and Responsibilities: Recording daily entries, reviewing documents and invoices, and classifying them accounting-wise. Following up on customer and supplier accounts, collections, receivables, and payment due dates. Issuing service invoices and following up on their collection in coordination with the relevant departments. Monitoring expenses, petty cash, and advances, and making necessary adjustments. Preparing bank reconciliations and matching balances regularly. Monitoring service revenues and costs and contributing to the preparation of their profitability reports. Contributing to monthly closing and preparing periodic financial reports. Preparing data and documents necessary for Zakat and tax work in coordination with the financial advisor. Organizing the financial archive and maintaining data confidentiality. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, or equivalent. Practical experience of 1 to 2 years in general accounting, preferably in service companies. Proficiency in using Excel and accounting software; experience with Odoo is an added advantage. Familiarity with the basics of VAT and e-invoicing in Saudi Arabia. Accuracy in data entry and review, and the ability to organize work and meet deadlines. Good communication, follow-up, and teamwork skills. Additional Details Number of vacancies: 1 Shift system: Morning only Benefits: Health insurance, social insurance, transportation allowance, housing, overtime

cb0b94b34d71d298.description: About Tronox Tronox is a global leader in the manufacturing of titanium dioxide (TiO2) pigment and other materials that enhance the brightness and durability of everyday products. With a workforce of 5,700 individuals across six continents, the company operates with a strong set of guiding values. Tronox is committed to responsibly transforming earth's resources into products and opportunities that improve lives, with a vision to shape a sustainable world through refined minerals. Role Overview: Shift Operator L The Shift Operator L is responsible for ensuring Safe Quality Low Cost Sustainable Tons (SQLCST) at their assigned post or workstation. This full-time position involves performing a range of activities across multiple areas, utilizing complex equipment to monitor operations and maintain product quality and inventory. The role also includes providing coaching and guidance to develop technical expertise within the company. Key Responsibilities Monitor and adjust process parameters to maintain safe and optimal conditions, ensuring smooth and stable operations. Prepare equipment for maintenance procedures. Accurately and promptly enter data into the shift logsheet, logbook, and Control Room system (*, SIC). Perform thorough and timely plant rounds to identify issues with plant/equipment and ensure safe, stable operations. Raise maintenance job requests in the system as applicable. Detect and report process deviations promptly, utilizing A3 investigation for process problems. Participate in incident investigations. Utilize IT systems for reporting and data gathering. Strictly follow and perform all normal and emergency start-up and shutdown tasks according to approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure safe, stable, and error-free operations. Ensure all shift handover requirements are detailed, easy to understand, and maintain continuity of plant/process performance. Operate plant/equipment independently (*, field, localized DCS). Collect and deliver in-process samples for laboratory analysis. Participate in and assist team members with various tasks. Required Qualifications and Skills 0-1 year of experience. Basic knowledge of plant operations, manufacturing processes, technical safety, and standard operating procedures. Strong commitment to Health, Safety, Environment, and Sustainability (SHE). Good communication, teamwork, problem-solving, and planning skills. Ability to work effectively in a shift-based operational environment. Work Location This full-time position is based in Al Madinah, with operations in Yanbu and Medina.

cb8d4d46ebb19235.description: About the Role Henkel is seeking a Regional Process Engineering Manager to join its team in Dammam. This full-time role involves driving process optimization and continuous improvement across manufacturing operations within the IMEA region and globally. The position requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in chemical manufacturing. Key Responsibilities Drive process optimization and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations. Lead engineering projects, including process upgrades, capital investments, and operational excellence programs. Provide technical expertise and troubleshooting support to improve safety, quality, productivity, and reliability. Collaborate with site, regional, and global teams to standardize best practices and implement innovative solutions. cbe1826fde202144.description: المهام والمسئوليات الرئيسية: معرفة التاريخ الصحي والطبي للمستفيد ومتابعة أي تطور أو ما يستجد عليه. تطبيق المقاييس الرسمية والغير رسمية المتبعة داخل الفرع مع جميع بالوقت المحدد والمجالات. اتباع الطرق التربوية في التعزيز وتعديل السلوك. تطبيق الجدول البصري وفي صورته الصحيحة. تحليل تطور المستفيد أو عدم مناسبة الخطة والنقاش مع المشرف/ة المساعدة بشكل مستمر. متابعة الخطة والتنسيق مع المشرف/ة المساعدة لفترته وتعديلها حسب الحاجة. تدريب المستفيد على المهارات الاستقلالية كاستخدام الحمام وتناول الوجبة وغيرها من المهارات الاستقلالية. الالتزام بمتابعة النظام الغذائي للمستفيد وعدم استخدام أساليب تعزيز غذائية مع الحميه. استلام العهد والأدوات والمحافظة عليها. إعداد الوسائل التعليمية بما يخدم البرنامج التدريبي والأنشطة الموجهة. حصر احتياجات البرنامج من وسائل وأدوات وتبليغ المشرف/ة. تسجيل الملاحظات بالسجل اليومي والرد على استفسارات الأهالي بلباقة ومهنية. تدوين الواجبات المنزلية لأولياء الأمور داخل تطبيق زيبرا بوكس مع وصف مبسط يسهل المتابعة للأهل. الالتزام بالرصد اليومي الالكتروني للمستفيد والتأكد من دقته. إغلاق الإضاءة والتكييف وترتيب الفصل وإغلاق الأدوات وتسليم مفتاح الجهازات لنهاية الدوام. تسليم المستفيد سواء لنهاية البرنامج مع جميع أغراضه التامة بداية أو بالتدريب تسلم للمساعدة. متابعة أداء المستفيدين وكتابة الملاحظات وتبليغ الإدارة الفنية حول أي طارئ أو تغيرات تخص المستفيد. التبليغ عند وجود أي عطل أو عطب أو مهام مطلوبة. التواصل مع الأهل بعد الرجوع للمشرف/ة. المساهمة في تواصل الأم الزائرة والتعامل مع استفسارات الأهالي بمرونة وموضوعية. التعاون مع الاخصائي/ة النفسي/ة في كتابة تقارير العيادة وتسليمها للمشرف/ة بالوقت المحدد. مراجعة التقارير الفصلية
